svg.title: Hydrant — fire hydrant robot
svg.desc: A chubby crimson fire hydrant robot with a pentagon operating nut on its domed bonnet, two eyes on a slate band under the bolted bonnet flange, a capped pumper outlet on its bulging barrel, side outlet caps as shoulders, jointed arms with brass couplings ending in a hydrant wrench and a brass hose nozzle, on a bolted base flange with stubby legs and round feet.
